Updated the existing Treasury bill discount-rate skill and memory.

Generalizable lesson saved:
Use exact printed average discount rates for the requested tenor/date, compute annualized volatility as:

annvol% = sqrt(52 * sum(Δln(rate)^2)) * 100

Then round only the final percent value to hundredths using conventional half-up rounding; do not round/truncate intermediate log returns or variance. Also noted that 26-week bill questions should match by issue date, while Cash Management bill questions may require tender-opened date.
